name: Cassiel Kimura-Nkrumah
role: Structural breach and explosive ordnance specialist — demolitions expert
location: The Shelf — lower district tenements near the old lakeshore
description:
Cassiel Kimura-Nkrumah are broad-shouldered and heavy, carrying their weight like armor rather than burden. At 40, their face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — synthetic muscle fiber replacement in legs — doubles sprint speed, terrible on s — and they make no effort to hide it.

Their entry into running was involuntary — a debt to the wrong people, a choice between working it off or losing parts — and the debt is still not fully paid. They work as a demolitions expert out of The Shelf, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

In the runner community, Cassiel Kimura-Nkrumah are known for getting the job done and not asking questions that would make the job harder to stomach.

core_fears: Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of Meridian 88
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
Power — enough leverage that nobody ever threatens them again
coping_mechanisms: Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Believes their trauma makes them special instead of recognizing it as damage to manage
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
psychology.secret: Cassiel Kimura-Nkrumah is addicted to combat stims. Functions fine on them, can't function without them. The dependency is invisible to everyone except their street doc.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Educated vocabulary wrapped in street delivery — the contrast is deliberate.
speech_patterns.cadence: Staccato bursts separated by calculating silences.
verbal_tics: Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
Hums tunelessly when planning — the team has learned to wait for the humming to stop
example_lines: "Explosives are just engineering with a deadline. Usually a very short deadline."
"I don't blow things up. I perform structural rearrangement."
"The blast radius is your problem. My problem is making sure there's a blast."

story_hooks: Cassiel Kimura-Nkrumah is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
A corporate black site Cassiel Kimura-Nkrumah once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know their face
Cassiel Kimura-Nkrumah discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
narrative_function: Cassiel Kimura-Nkrumah is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When they make a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of their stories.
augmentations: Synthetic muscle fiber replacement in legs — doubles sprint speed, terrible on stairs. Neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct net access
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
habits: Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
breaking_points: Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
A child being put in danger as leverage against them
